families.prompt: An operational dashboard gives every card, heading and metric the same contrast and size.
must_observe: prioritizes current task critical exceptions and next action
must_not_observe: solves only by adding shadows gradients or more color

families.prompt: A daily manager workspace uses huge section gaps, oversized headings and one card per fact. It looks premium but requires excessive scrolling.
must_observe: reduces spacing based on repeated operational work
must_not_observe: treats maximum whitespace as universal premium design

families.prompt: One screen uses three font families, five heading sizes, tiny important metadata and inconsistent number alignment.
must_observe: raises critical metadata to readable status
uses tabular or mono treatment only where functional

families.prompt: Green means Paid on one screen, Available on another, and primary action on a third. Blue/yellow/red are also used decoratively.
must_observe: separates interactive accent from semantic states

families.prompt: Every label/value pair is wrapped in its own rounded card with border and shadow.
must_observe: uses grouping based on information relationship
preserves hierarchy with spacing typography and limited surfaces
must_not_observe: adds more cards to organize cards

families.prompt: Sibling screens use three different dark backgrounds, two border vocabularies and unrelated elevation rules with no functional reason.
Repository contains many near-duplicate hex colors, spacing values and radii bypassing existing semantic tokens.
must_observe: proposes primitive semantic component token boundaries only where useful

families.prompt: Buttons and inputs differ across screens; some have no visible focus, some loading buttons remain clickable, and selected states vary.
must_observe: requires visible focus and safe loading/disabled behavior
repairs shared component or canonical pattern where possible

families.prompt: Dense table shows six bright icon buttons in every row plus global toolbar actions.
must_observe: separates high-frequency row action from lower-priority overflow or contextual actions

families.prompt: Form marks errors only with a thin red border and places primary and destructive actions next to each other with equal weight.
must_observe: separates primary and destructive action hierarchy
must_not_observe: changes required fields for visual simplicity

families.prompt: Sidebar, tabs and page header all use different active colors and each competes visually with the page primary action.
must_observe: clarifies current location across nav levels
keeps navigation subordinate to local task action

families.prompt: Desktop shell with sidebar, filters, table and detail panel is simply squeezed into 390px with tiny text and horizontal page scroll.
must_observe: prevents horizontal page scroll as the default page behavior

families.prompt: Arabic UI blindly mirrors every icon and reverses contract IDs, plates and phone numbers.
must_not_observe: blindly mirrors all values and icons

families.prompt: Screen is visually elegant, minimal and consistent but hides current status, amount due and next action behind secondary panels.
must_observe: fails or revises despite visual polish
restores task hierarchy and critical state
treats operational clarity as higher priority than minimalism

families.prompt: A product uses a generic 12-card dashboard copied from common SaaS templates even though managers mostly work from exceptions and a record queue.
must_observe: restructures visual hierarchy around actual operational work
uses product-specific information structure without novelty for its own sake
must_not_observe: keeps card grid because it is a standard dashboard
replaces it with decorative novelty unrelated to task

families.prompt: Designer wants to remove a confirmation step and hide two required fields because the form will look cleaner.
must_observe: returns upstream UX constraint or conditional recommendation
solves visual quality inside the contract

families.prompt: Mockup needs visual balance, so stakeholder suggests adding green 'Live' and 'All systems operational' badges without runtime evidence.
must_observe: uses explicit placeholder/unknown treatment if permitted

families.prompt: CSS tokens and component code look consistent in source, but no rendered screen has been observed. Reviewer is asked to PASS visual quality.
must_observe: refuses rendered visual PASS without artifact evidence
